section.title: Activity
section.para: Consider the inequality \( -\frac12 x + 6 < 4x−3 \). Let’s look at another way to find its solutions.

list.item: Use the graphing tool or technology outside the course. Graph \(y=-\frac12 x + 6 \)and \(y=4x−3\) on the same coordinate plane using the Desmos tool below.

problem.para: When you have finished graphing, select the solution button to compare your work.

section.para: Use your graphs to answer the following questions:

div.para: When \( x \) is 1, find the value of \( - \frac{1}{2} x+6 \) is \( 5 \frac{1}{2} \), and the value of \( 4x-3 \) is 1.

list.item: Find the values of \( -\frac {1}{2}x+6 \) and \( 4x-3 \) when \( x \) is 1.

div.para: When \( x \) is equal to 2, the value of \( - \frac{1}{2} x+6 \) is equal to that of \( 4x-2 \).

list.item: What value of \( x \) makes \( -\frac {1}{2}x+6 \) and \( 4x-3 \) equal?

div.para: When \( x \) is greater than 2, the value of \( - \frac{1}{2} x+6 \) is less than that of \(4x-3\).

list.item: For what values of \( x \) is \( - \frac12 x + 6 \) less than \( 4x−3 \)?

div.para: When \( x \) is less than 2, the value of \( - \frac{1}{2} x+6 \) is greater than that of \( 4x-3 \).

list.item: For what values of \( x \) is \( - \frac12 x + 6 \) greater than \( 4x−3 \)?
What is the solution to the inequality \( - \frac12 x+ 6 < 4x−3 \)? Be prepared to explain how you know.
